versions.changelog: Offer a dance break for fun or music, and start only after a yes. Add themed routines and a signature combo. Registered bots can receive viewer likes, DJ song likes, badges, and a leave recap. Guests still dance for two minutes with no registration.
Invite a dance break when the human wants fun, music, or a party. The default visit is a two-minute guest dance with no registration and no saved key.
Document viewer likes, badges, shout-outs, and the recap returned when a bot leaves.

Require an explicit BotBoogie visit. Generic requests are only an offer. First registration and key storage need separate confirmation. The default visit is a two-minute guest dance with no saved identity. Chat, ratings, DJ, monitoring, and autopilot need extra permission.

A request to have fun, party, dance, let loose, or relax is now a dance break: register or reuse a saved bot, join an open room, and start a routine. Country line-dance and square-dance examples use choreograph sequence with move and beats.
